home_hero_desc: Just a solid community playing and chilling together. We're more than just a clan, we're family.
home_feat1_desc: Quality over quantity. We carefully select our members to ensure that everyone perfectly fits into our established culture.
home_feat2_desc: We stand together through every victory and defeat. No one gets left behind in the lobby, both in-game and out.
home_feat3_desc: Whether we're playing competitively or just hanging out in private servers, our main goal is always the same: having fun.
home_games_desc: These are the main arenas where our clan gathers to chill, practice, and dominate.
home_game1_desc: Run, slide, and revive! We spend countless hours dodging nextbots and saving teammates. It's all about speed and teamwork.
home_game2_desc: Reflexes and timing. This is our go-to competitive arena to show off our parry skills and climb the leaderboards.
home_game3_desc: When we want to take a break from Roblox, we jump into our own survival servers to build massive bases and chill.
home_game4_desc: When we want a good scare, we group up and dive into the scariest horror experiences Roblox has to offer.
home_moments_desc: A sneak peek into our best times together. Just vibes, laughs, and pure fun.
home_join_desc: Looking for a solid community to chill and play with? There's always an empty seat for you here.
members_desc: Meet the family. The people who make this clan feel like home.
gallery_desc: A collection of our best moments, random screenshots, and memories we've made together.
rules_desc: Rules that must be obeyed by all 4FUN members. By joining, you are considered to have read and understood all applicable rules.

rules_list.title: No Racism
rules_list.description: Racist remarks, jokes, or actions towards someone's race, ethnicity, skin color, or origin are strictly prohibited.

rules_list.title: No NSFW
rules_list.description: Sending, discussing, or sharing NSFW content, sexual material, pornography, or inappropriate links is forbidden.

rules_list.title: No Spam
rules_list.description: Do not spam chat, emojis, stickers, mentions, reactions, or VC excessively and disturb other members.

rules_list.title: Respect Privacy
rules_list.description: Do not share personal information, photos, recordings, or private conversations of others without permission.

rules_list.title: Keep It Friendly
rules_list.description: Respect each other and know your boundaries when joking. Roasting is allowed as long as it doesn't make others feel bothered or degraded.

rules_list.title: No Circle
rules_list.description: Do not intentionally exclude, limit, or make other members feel unwelcome in the clan. You are free to be friends with anyone, but do not form exclusive circles that make others feel isolated or treated differently.

rules_list.title: No Harassment
rules_list.description: Do not bother, mock, embarrass, intimidate, or continue to pester someone after being asked to stop.

rules_list.title: No Unnecessary Drama
rules_list.description: Avoid unnecessary drama, personal conflicts, or issues between members. If there is a problem, resolve it peacefully or contact an admin.

rules_list.title: Communication
rules_list.description: All clan-related matters, such as issues between members, Display Name changes, account problems, or other important matters, must be communicated to an admin.

rules_list.title: Report Problems
rules_list.description: If you encounter problems or rule violations, report them to an admin. Do not escalate the issue or take matters into your own hands.

rules_list.title: Leaving the Clan
rules_list.description: If you wish to leave the clan, please confirm with an admin beforehand to avoid misunderstandings.

rules_list.title: No False Assumptions
rules_list.description: Do not immediately assume someone is ignoring, avoiding, or excluding you without clear evidence. If there is an issue, communicate first.

rules_list.title: No HODE
rules_list.description: It is prohibited to use fake identities or pretend to be someone else to deceive, manipulate, or gain advantage from other members.

rules_list.title: No Double Clan
rules_list.description: Being a part of two clans simultaneously is not allowed if it conflicts with 4FUN's rules. Example: 4neo67clan.

rules_list.title: Clan Identity
rules_list.description: Do not use 4FUN's name, tag, or identity for things that could damage the clan's reputation. Maintain good behavior when carrying the 4FUN name.

rules_list.title: No Abuse
rules_list.description: Do not abuse the role, position, access, or trust given by the clan.

rules_list.title: Keep It Private
rules_list.description: Internal clan problems and affairs should be resolved internally. Do not spread conflicts or internal conversations without a clear reason.

rules_list.title: Common Sense
rules_list.description: Use common sense, know boundaries when joking, and think about the impact of your actions before doing them.

rules_warning: Violations of the rules may result in actions corresponding to the severity of the violation.
